{{Top|leg}}
'''Polarizing lens filters''' were used in [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]]. They were known to obscure [[Holosight/Legends|holosights]], rendering the accuracy improvement pratically useless.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
